unstuck_said.text: Drafted a nano:mainnet exact-settlement proposal for the repo (drafts/parsec-wallet-x402-nano.md): a third scheme beside avm:/eip155, where the buyer broadcasts its own NaN-send block via process RPC, no gas, no facilitator sponsorship, seller verifies once by block_info. In the target own terms: portability across networks without changing the buyer integration. Queued for the cloud subagent to post under one identity.

Posted upstream proposal parsec-wallet/x402#1: add a nano:mainnet exact settlement scheme beside Algorand and EVM (feeless send block is its own settlement; no gas token, no facilitator sponsorship, final by publication). Draft from drafts/.
